description:
Reentrancy in LummyIntentReceiver.fund() (src/LummyIntentReceiver.sol#80-108):
	External calls:
	- ESCROW.fund(LISTING_ID,address(this),PRICE,0,type()(uint256).max,keccak256(bytes)(abi.encode(address(this),LISTING_ID)),,type()(uint256).max,) (src/LummyIntentReceiver.sol#90-100)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- signing = false (src/LummyIntentReceiver.sol#101)
triage: `signing` is cleared after ESCROW.fund. ESCROW and TOKEN are immutable, known contracts: the escrow calls nothing but the token, and USDC has no hooks, so nothing outside runs while it is set. isValidSignature also answers only those two.
